text: At critique level C3 the paper reports accuracy improving in both tasks, from 60.94% at C2 to 67.19% on CET-6 and from 90.62% to 93.75% on GAOKAO Math. The text states that majority voting at comparable effort reaches 67.19% and 93.75%, that naive voting is substantially below average accuracy at each level, and that confidence rises while completion time falls across levels.
title: Critique level C3 further improves accuracy on CET-6 and GAOKAO Math
